closure_gate: All15 physical fits and all9 family records complete; all exact2700 update traces present; successful physical exits, source/data/runtime preservation and complete checkpoint/logit/metric replays. Missing, failed, qualification-only or unselected cases stop comparison.
stage_restore: Construct exact fresh native/family, load strict model state, restore explicit _global/native/wrapper flags and eval modes; stage from each selected image can be local. No optimizer/seed/RNG state dropped when qualifying full portable images.
logit_gate: Full float32 [4,24492,5] per four-member family assembled in fixed member order and [1,24492,5] native; all finite; checkpoint descriptors exactly selected per member; raw logit parity required before probabilities or metrics.
control_release: Separate evaluation authority after complete fit closure; TRAIN-control label values are already part of compact official TRAIN derivation, but control predictive scores may first be computed after closure. Official TEST labels have no allowed reader.
pooling: Class softmax of each complete member trajectory; arithmetic mean all4 probabilities, same formula for GNNM and independent. Independent logits come from each individually native-accuracy-selected checkpoint, not one ensemble-selected epoch.

metrics_arithmetic.VAL_selection_and_control_accuracy: FP32 native softmax/mean probabilities and deterministic lowest-class argmax tie; native single argmax raw logits
metrics_arithmetic.primary_control_NLL: Stable FP64 log_softmax of each saved raw member logit, then logsumexp over members minus log(K), negative mean selected-label log probability; no probability clipping or fitted temperature
metrics_arithmetic.Brier: FP64 mean member probabilities; mean sum_c(p_c - onehot_c)^2; no division by class count
metrics_arithmetic.member_NLL: Stable FP64 per-member log_softmax at each own selected checkpoint
metrics_arithmetic.metric_saved_logit_recomputation: Exact same frozen arithmetic/dtype/node order; tolerance absolute1e-6 relative0 if independent same-runtime recomputation needs a numerical gate, fixed before any outcome

comparison: NLL_GNNM4 - NLL_independent4 per three complete block pairs and arithmetic mean; report all pairs, native single/members, costs/stages. No post-outcome exclusions, recipes, regularizers, weighting or novelty/superiority certificate.
revalidation: Repeat source-review/admission/source manifest/seal/input/cohort/checkpoint/logit/cost hashes after reads before coherent atomic comparison freeze; physical exit/failure markers remain authoritative.
